subject: Agriculture
title: Agroecology vs. Industrial Scale
description: One-minute skill: Agroecology vs. Industrial Scale.

hook.text: Can small, ecological farms feed the world? Or do we need industrial scale? The debate splits experts.

buildup.text: Small farms produce 30% of global food on 24% of cropland. They're more productive per hectare than large farms.

discovery.text: Agroecological methods can match industrial yields while preserving biodiversity and soil health.

twist.text: Industrial agriculture feeds cities efficiently through supply chains that small farms can't easily access.

climax.text: The answer isn't one or the other—it's appropriate scale for each context, with support for both.

punchline.text: Small farms are efficient. Large farms are connected. Both are needed.

quiz.question: What share of global food do small farms produce?
